glossary.definition: (A) "Mediation" means any process in which a mediator facilitates communication and negotiation between parties to assist them in reaching a voluntary agreement regarding their dispute.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2710.01 to 2710.10 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Mediation communication" means a statement, whether oral, in a record, verbal or nonverbal, that occurs during a mediation or is made for purposes of considering, conducting, participating in, initiating, continuing, or reconvening a mediation or retaining a mediator.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2710.01 to 2710.10 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Mediator" means an individual who conducts a mediation.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2710.01 to 2710.10 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Nonparty participant" means a person, other than a party or mediator, that participates in a mediation.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2710.01 to 2710.10 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (E) "Mediation party" means a person that participates in a mediation and whose agreement is necessary to resolve the dispute.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2710.01 to 2710.10 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (F) "Person" means an individual, corporation, business trust, estate, trust, partnership, limited liability company, association, joint venture, agency or instrumentality of the state or of any political subdivision of the state, public corporation, or any other legal or commercial entity.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2710.01 to 2710.10 of the Revised Code:
As used in sections 2710.01 to 2710.10 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (H) "Record" means information that is inscribed on a tangible medium or that is stored in an electronic or other medium and is retrievable in perceivable form.
